sentence_stem: Because my phone battery was dead,
correct_completion: I could not reply to your message.
full_sentence: Because my phone battery was dead, I could not reply to your message.
acceptable_variants: I could not answer your text.
I did not send a reply.

options.text: I will buy a new phone tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: This is a possible future plan, but it does not follow as a result of the battery being dead in this sentence.

options.text: so I went to the cinema.
options.why_wrong: Going to the cinema is not a logical result of a dead battery, and 'so' does not fit after 'because' here.

options.text: I could not reply to your message.

options.why_wrong: This describes a different event and does not follow logically from the battery being dead.

explanation: The word 'because' introduces the reason, so the main clause must give the result of that reason. The result must logically follow from the cause in the first part.
translation: Porque a bateria do meu celular estava descarregada, não consegui responder à sua mensagem.
